name: get_server_health
description: Read operational health from a selected FrontierStack Mac: services, monitors, disks, certificates and alerts it watches.

name: get_fleet_context
description: Return the selected Mac’s secret-redacted map of servers, roles, services, network locations and operating conventions, including the names of its linked servers.

name: get_alert_errors
description: List outstanding alert and report delivery errors (email, Slack, SMS, push and similar) with likely causes and fixes.

name: diagnose
description: Run one bounded, read-only diagnostic program on the selected Mac or a linked server. Arguments are passed directly, never through a shell, and time limits are applied. argv[0] must be one of: ping, ping6, dig, nslookup, host, traceroute, nc (with -z), curl (GET/HEAD), ifconfig, netstat, route, arp,

name: read_logs
description: Read a bounded tail of a log on the selected Mac or a linked server. Secrets are removed before the text leaves the Mac.

name: service_action
description: Check, start, stop or restart one supported Homebrew web service on the selected Mac. status is read-only; stop and restart interrupt the service. Changes run only if the owner allowed changes on that Mac, and may wait for the owner's approval there.

name: replace_credential
description: Ask the owner to type a new value for one of the selected Mac’s stored credentials (an API key or token FrontierStack keeps, such as openai, anthropic, cloudflare or stripe) on a secure FrontierStack page, for example after a key has leaked. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_alert_errors · Private data: get_fleet_context, read_logs, replace_credential · Public sink: get_alert_errors · Destructive: diagnose, service_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_alert_errors · Private data: get_fleet_context, read_logs, replace_credential · Public sink: get_alert_errors · Destructive: diagnose, service_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
